items.requirement: A requested legacy run requires one deployment YAML path.
Input paths stay inside the committed repository.
Projects explicitly declare raw manifests and Helm charts without broad discovery.
Input file count, file size, rendered size, and document count are bounded.
Invalid YAML cannot pass.
Every declared YAML document is parsed with bounded aliases.
Raw Kubernetes YAML is checked against a strict versioned schema.
Rendered Helm output is checked against the same strict schema.
Schema validation cannot fetch data during a pipeline run.
Required environment variables are checked.
Secret key references are checked.
Private registry images require pull credentials.
Readiness and liveness probes are checked.
CPU and memory limits are checked.
Operator-approved policy packs are versioned and digest verified.
Projects can select only installed policy pack identifiers.
Policy findings include the exact source file and a line when the parser supplies one.
Schema output, input digests, rendered digests, and pack digests remain bounded evidence.
The replacement is experimental during implementation and cannot change the gate.
The legacy manifest suite remains authoritative until parity and cutover.
One valid container must not hide a missing probe or limit on another container.
One Secret file must not be the only Secret reference authority.
envFrom must resolve declared Secret or ConfigMap keys when available.
ServiceAccount imagePullSecrets must count as valid credentials.
Several workload documents must retain separate identities and locations.
Console summaries must not replace structured findings and source evidence.
Manifest, chart, pack, and schema paths reject traversal and symlink escape.
Live Kubernetes apply and runtime checks remain outside static lint.
